remarks: *The sellers have received multiple offers and are requesting all offers be submitted by 4:00PM on Wednesday, 3/25/26.* This well-maintained Ranch in the sought-after Cranbury neighborhood of Norwalk offers the ease and comfort of true one-level living. The functional layout makes everyday living simple, while a screened-in sun porch provides the perfect space to relax and enjoy the level, fully fenced in half acre backyard-ideal for outdoor entertaining, pets, or gardening. A one-car garage and storage shed add practicality, and the manageable lot makes this home easy to maintain for those seeking a low-maintenance lifestyle. Conveniently located just minutes from Metro-North train service, major commuter routes, shopping, and dining, this property offers both comfort and accessibility. Central air, house generator hook-up and city water add another layer of convenience and reliability to this well situated and convenient home. Contingent on sellers closing on their new home, they are under contract and through inspections. House is sold as-is.
